scope: Independent full qualitative task/key solutions;no numerical curriculum registry or emf derivation required. Vector arithmetic is reviewer verification only.
geometry_coordinates: B along+x;v in xy;active wire alongz;dot(v cross B,wire) verifies relative motional effect,not universal meter sign.

solutions.GEM1: Draw existing aligned-within-domain regions with mixed net directions before;field favours domain growth/reorientation;soft iron loses much magnetisation after removal but residual effects depend history. Model is not microscopy.
solutions.GEM2: DC coil or nearby magnet aligns/responds to applied field;consistent pole/direction stroking provides directed magnetising influence;mechanical disturbance in a field can assist. No reliable polarity from unspecified hammering,or universal most suitable method;use control/material/retention criteria. Magnetic induction of iron differs from voltage induction.
solutions.GEM3: Alternating diminishing field cycles toward low net remanence;appropriate heat or disturbance with external-field conditions can reduce order. Tapping in an aligning field can have opposite effect. No live methods provided;unperformed until separately approved.
solutions.GEM4: Draw labelled N/S,noncrossing closed lines external N-to-S/internal S-to-N and tangent compass north end. Density qualitative under consistent convention. Optional real directions must be recorded at marked positions;Earth field can matter.
solutions.GEM5: A unchanged configuration no induced emf;B changing linked flux yes;C appropriate moving open rod can separate charges/voltage without closed current;D changing separate-coil current can induce in stationary loop. Emf energy per charge,not mechanical force;input energy required.
solutions.GEM6: Explicit vector calculation above:stationary/parallel zero,up/down equal opposite signs,angled smaller nonzero at equal speed. Active wire aligned with v-cross-B. Wiring maps physical polarity to meter-right arbitrarily.
solutions.GEM7: Actual school no-external-power circuit,zero/sensitivity/geometry precheck,actual setup drawing,all4 movements,baseline/reversal/repeats,roles/date/directions/readings or undetectable results required. A supplied table does not count as outcome d. Return-lead movement can contribute;control it.
solutions.GEM8: Given upward-right convention:field reversal alone left;both field/motion reversals restore right. This is a relative sign,not universal wiring. Moving lead contributes motional/flux change;fix return leads outside gap and compare controlled motion.
solutions.GEM9: Greater relevant perpendicular speed,B,proper active length increase motional magnitude if other conditions fixed;additional linked turns affect separate coil model with same change per turn. Arbitrary length/turns insufficient. Qualitative data do not independently establish exact ratios,even when an ideal law predicts them.
solutions.GEM10: Generator mechanical work converts to electrical energy through linked change;transformer changing electrical input transfers energy via changing field;induction heating uses induced dissipative currents. Steady primary current gives no continuing ideal secondary induction after transients. Bell primarily electromagnetic attraction plus feedback;switching self-induction does not make it a generator.
solutions.GEM11: A domains already exist;B presence alone insufficient;C vector geometry matters;D energy must enter;E battery bell not generation. For each,uncertainty/qualification is material remanence,field/loop/circuit change,wire/lead geometry,input/losses,or contact/core/current details respectively. Generator with mechanical input or transformer with changing primary is valid daily example.
solutions.GEM12: Series path supply-switch-contact-coil-return,mechanical armature-contact linkage opens when attracted,spring recloses as field falls. Soft core low retention aids release. Need both circuit AND mechanical drawings. Rated current-limited supply with compatible coil,insulation/stability/contacts approved before power;design alone no making evidence.
solutions.GEM13: Approved disconnected assembly,teacher inspection,brief test ≤5s or shorter rating,disconnect/check before adjustment,record actual role/date/product/failure or cycle,power-off correction and approved retest. Correct diagnosis may be contact not opening/reclosing,insufficient permitted pull,wrong spacing or residual retention;never bypass safety to fix. No resources means plan-only status.
solutions.GEM14: All4 claims fail:table not actual GEM7;drawing not actual GEM13;stationary magnet not energy source;hammering depends field/material/history and soft iron not reliably permanent. Two uses generator/transformer need mechanical/changing electrical inputs. New evidence opportunities require school approval.
solutions.GEM15_I1: Two valid magnetisation and two conditional demagnetisation descriptions suffice as prompt asks;not all methods mandatory. Domain reasoning,low relative retention,hammering qualifications and complete field/compass model required.
solutions.GEM15_I2: Four movement predictions/reversals as above,closed current path versus open voltage,actual GEM7 observation missing. Supplied meter responses not fabricated experimental records.
solutions.GEM15_I3: All4 listed factors with appropriate straight-wire/coil distinction,held controls and orientation;given qualitative records do not show exact multipliers.
solutions.GEM15_I4: One generator OR transformer explained with energy/change;bell core/current/feedback contrast;none of actual practical/project/digital actions established by writing.
